02 / SAVE & SHARE

Save your work. Share by choice.

Save your finished design as a draft. Find it in My designs whenever you want to edit, redesign or print it.

A little reminder: sharing needs your permission

When saving, you will see a privacy and sharing choice. Only after you agree will your design appear in Works center for others to view, like, reuse or print. Leave it unchecked to keep a private draft.

Works center and design details show the artwork, author and phone-model tag.

03 / PRINT & RECEIVE

Love it? Bring it to life.

Print a design as soon as you love it, or return to My designs later to print or redesign it. Review your artwork, create an order and choose how to receive your case.

Nearby printing

Choose a nearby printer and follow the order’s directions to the location to print your case.

Ship to home

Enter your delivery address and have your case shipped home. US$4 shipping, estimated arrival in 3–4 days.
